pattern.short_summary: The user selects two or more existing items and invokes an operation whose product is a single fused result rather than either operand.
pattern.definition: The user selects two or more existing items and invokes an operation whose product is a single fused result rather than either operand. The blend may be continuous (interpolation along a mixing control) or discrete (a synthesized recombination). The operands remain identifiable as the things being combined, and the fusion is the system's contribution.
pattern.structural_signature: An operator takes two or more selected items as arguments and returns a result in the same space as the arguments; where the mixing is continuous, a control exposes the position between operands. Selecting the operands and invoking the operator are separate acts, and the result can itself become an operand.

dimension.category_description: How multiple possibilities are presented, previewed, maintained, blended, or compared before commitment.
dimension.classification_boundary: Requires a visible choice or comparison mechanism, not backend candidate-set processing alone.
